hypothesis.claim: The already frozen FOSSIL-MATCH transition exposes at least 313,775 exactly verified far-history opportunities on the complete 587,138,826-byte transformed stream, and its continuation beats the ring-alias, random, and negated controls in every chronological third and at least two distance buckets without consulting any parent probability.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire this exact 16-byte-key, 2^24-record, most-recent replacement transition as a 105M-scale source if either repeat differs, fewer than 313,775 bytes activate, any chronological third fails the matched-control margin, fewer than two distance buckets pass, causality fails, or the bounded census exceeds its resource guard.

changedMechanism: Remove only the obsolete q1-qualification activation dependency from the already frozen zero-credit source census; preserve the FOSSIL transition, population, controls, hashes, table geometry, and update order exactly.
invariants: The scanner source is the immutable fxcm_fossil_match_q0_v3 source with SHA-256 d92061f3d179a6ef8dcaaf9403a389a6be04dbd36b6e2d8ec4bd916524f04e9a.
The scanner consumes the exact 587,138,826-byte transformed-ready population with SHA-256 7826ff63dedd526c119dda08e6e044be8fa8f6e89a55f3d6b1f3447cdfc5c1ce.

The 16-byte modulo-2^64 rolling hash, 2^24 direct-mapped records, exact historical-key verification, strict greater-than-16,777,216 distance gate, unconditional post-truth replacement, and no-continuation-state rule remain unchanged.
D, S, R, and N are computed from state through i-1 and scored before truth changes the table, ring, hash, or counters.
K traverses the identical state transition with prediction disabled, and no control outcome can influence later treatment state.
The census never opens a parent probability trace, archive, corpus suffix, semantic sidecar, or q1 qualification artifact.
The 313,775 active-byte threshold is only an optimistic 16-byte-per-active-byte quantization envelope for the current 5,020,395-byte gross requirement; it is not measured compression.
A pass authorizes one retained-parent probability trace on matching coordinates, not native integration or score credit.

Execute all scanner state transitions and hashes while emitting no prediction.

At every D-active coordinate, emit the frozen SplitMix64 control byte.
At every D-active coordinate, emit the bitwise complement of D.
